# Job Description

## Placement Senior Manager / Manager – CDOE

\*\*Organisation:\*\* Shoolini University

\*\*Centre:\*\* Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE)

\*\*Location:\*\* Hyderabad

\*\*Experience:\*\* 5–10 years

\*\*Qualification:\*\* MBA or Postgraduate Degree preferred

\*\*Department:\*\* Career Services & Corporate Relations

### About Shoolini University – CDOE

Shoolini University’s Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE) is committed to delivering accessible, industry-relevant education that empowers learners to advance their careers. The Centre aims to strengthen employability through industry engagement, career development initiatives, corporate partnerships, and placement support for distance and online education learners.

### Role Overview

Shoolini University is seeking an experienced and results-oriented Placement Senior Manager / Manager to lead placement and career advancement initiatives for CDOE learners. The role will focus on building strong corporate relationships, developing employment opportunities, facilitating recruitment drives, and creating career pathways for MBA, postgraduate, and other eligible learners.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of corporate hiring requirements, proven experience in placements or talent acquisition, excellent networking skills, and the ability to drive measurable placement outcomes across industries.

### Key Responsibilities

\*\*1. Corporate Relations & Employer Partnerships\*\*

- Develop and manage relationships with corporates, recruitment agencies, industry bodies, and potential hiring partners.

- Build a strong employer network across sectors such as IT/ITeS, BFSI, consulting, FMCG, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and emerging industries.

- Identify employment opportunities aligned with the qualifications, experience, and career aspirations of CDOE learners.

- Establish strategic hiring partnerships, including preferred hiring arrangements, recruitment collaborations, and internship opportunities where applicable.

\*\*2. Placement Strategy & Execution\*\*

- Develop and implement placement strategies for eligible MBA, postgraduate, and other CDOE learners.

- Drive placement opportunities through campus recruitment, virtual hiring drives, off-campus recruitment, job fairs, and employer-led recruitment campaigns.

- Coordinate end-to-end placement activities, from employer outreach and candidate shortlisting to interview scheduling, offer management, and joining follow-ups.

- Facilitate lateral hiring opportunities for working professionals seeking career progression or a transition into new roles.

- Develop placement plans and hiring calendars aligned with learner profiles and employer requirements.

\*\*3. Career Development & Learner Engagement\*\*

- Assess learner profiles, work experience, skills, and career aspirations to improve job-role alignment.

- Coordinate with academic teams to identify employability gaps and support relevant training, resume-building, interview preparation, and career counselling initiatives.

- Organise webinars, industry interactions, career talks, mock interviews, and employer engagement sessions.

- Guide learners on job search strategies, professional networking, interview readiness, and career advancement.

\*\*4. Employer & Recruitment Ecosystem Development\*\*

- Build and maintain a database of hiring organisations, recruiters, job opportunities, and placement outcomes.

- Engage with HR leaders, talent acquisition heads, business leaders, and recruitment consultants to understand workforce requirements.

- Explore partnerships for internships, apprenticeships, live projects, and other relevant experiential opportunities.

- Maintain regular communication with employers to gather feedback and strengthen long-term hiring relationships.

\*\*5. Placement Operations, MIS & Reporting\*\*

- Track and report placement-related KPIs, including employer partnerships, job opportunities, interview participation, offers, joining rates, and learner engagement.

- Maintain accurate placement records, employer databases, recruitment calendars, and management dashboards.

- Prepare periodic placement reports and present progress, challenges, and improvement plans to university leadership.

- Ensure transparent communication with learners and employers throughout the recruitment process.

- Track outcomes in accordance with institutional placement policies and applicable guidelines.

\*\*6. Team Management & Stakeholder Coordination\*\*

- Lead and coordinate placement executives or career services team members, as applicable.

- Work closely with CDOE leadership, academic departments, learner support teams, and marketing teams to improve placement participation and outcomes.

- Number of active corporate hiring partnerships established.

- Number of relevant job opportunities generated for eligible learners.

- Employer satisfaction and repeat hiring partnerships.

description:
**About ScienceLogic…**
=======================

ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self-healing, self-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.  
  
We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.

**What we’re looking for…**

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Benefits & HR Operations Specialist to join our People team in Hyderabad, India. This role will play a key part in supporting our global employees, with primary responsibility for benefits administration and significant hands-on ownership of global HR operations across the employee lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience administering employee benefits in India, working knowledge of U.S. benefits programs and practices, and substantial prior experience independently administering core employee lifecycle processes in a global organization. You’ll serve as a trusted resource for employees, helping them navigate benefits, leave programs, onboarding, employment changes, offboarding, and other HR processes while partnering closely with our global People team, Payroll, Finance, benefits brokers, carriers, and other external vendors.

Beyond benefits, this is a senior, hands-on HR Operations role. The successful candidate will have material, prior experience across the employee lifecycle disciplines this position will own, enabling them to quickly establish and maintain a solid, scalable global HR foundation.

**What you will be doing…**

**Benefits Administration – India & U.S.**

* Support the day-to-day administration of employee benefit programs across India and the United States, ensuring employees receive timely and accurate guidance.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for employee questions related to benefits, eligibility, enrollment, qualifying life events, leave programs, and other benefit-related matters.
* Manage and support India benefits programs, including group medical and insurance programs, Provident Fund (PF), Employees' State Insurance (ESI), gratuity, statutory leave and other applicable employee benefits.
* Support administration of U.S. health and welfare programs, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, retirement programs, and other company-sponsored benefits.
* Maintain working knowledge of U.S. benefits requirements and programs, including ERISA, COBRA, ACA and FMLA, and partner with U.S.-based HR team members and vendors on administration and compliance.
* Coordinate and support annual Open Enrollment activities across applicable regions, including employee communications, system updates, enrollment activities, and issue resolution.
* Support leave administration across both countries, partnering with employees, HR team members, Payroll, and third-party administrators as appropriate.
* Process and reconcile benefit enrollments, changes, terminations, dependent updates, and qualifying life events.
* Partner with benefits brokers, insurance carriers, third-party administrators, Payroll, and other vendors to resolve employee questions and discrepancies.
* Support benefit renewals, audits, invoice reconciliation, eligibility reviews, reporting, and data validation.
* Assist with the development and delivery of employee benefits communications, educational materials, and resources.
* Maintain awareness of evolving benefits regulations and statutory requirements in both India and the U.S., escalating compliance questions as appropriate.

**Global HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Administration**

* Independently lead and administer day-to-day global HR operations throughout the employee lifecycle, including pre-employment activities, onboarding, employee changes, transfers, promotions, leaves, and offboarding.
* Own global onboarding administration, including new-hire documentation, data entry, required approvals, policy acknowledgments, background and pre-employment coordination as applicable, benefits and payroll handoffs, and completion tracking.
* Administer employee changes accurately and on time, including job, compensation, manager, location, status, and organizational changes, coordinating closely with Payroll and other stakeholders.
* Lead termination and offboarding processing, including required documentation, HRIS updates, final payroll and benefits coordination, access and equipment notifications, employee communications, and maintenance of appropriate records in accordance with country-specific requirements.
* Process employment verifications and other employee documentation requests accurately, promptly, and with appropriate authorization and confidentiality.
* Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready employee data, personnel records, and documentation within the HRIS and other People systems, applying appropriate retention, privacy, and access practices.
* Provide HR compliance and audit support, including document collection, data validation, recurring reporting, employment records, policy acknowledgments, statutory or regulatory submissions, and responses to internal and external requests.
* Respond to general employee HR inquiries, resolve routine operational matters independently, and appropriately escalate employee relations, policy, legal, or complex compliance matters.
* Maintain and continuously improve global HR policies, employee resources, standard operating procedures, checklists, controls, and process documentation, ensuring consistent execution while accounting for country-specific requirements.
* Identify and implement opportunities to streamline, automate, and strengthen benefits and HR operational processes, controls, service levels, and the employee experience; support broader People team projects as business needs evolve.

**Qualities you possess…**

* 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in Benefits, Global HR Operations, Human Resources, or a related field, including meaningful hands-on benefits administration and senior-level ownership of employee lifecycle processes.
* Strong knowledge of India employee benefits and statutory programs, including PF, ESI, gratuity, insurance programs, and applicable leave requirements.
* Working knowledge of U.S. employee benefits, including health and welfare programs, retirement benefits, leave administration, and applicable regulations.
* Familiarity with U.S. benefits regulations such as ERISA, COBRA, ACA, HIPAA, and FMLA is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience independently leading and administering global employee lifecycle operations, including onboarding, employee changes, transfers, promotions, leaves, offboarding and termination processing, employment verifications, personnel records, and routine HR compliance support.
* Material prior experience operating within a global or multi-country HR environment, with the ability to apply consistent processes and controls while appropriately addressing local legal, statutory, cultural, and operational requirements.
* Hands-on experience establishing, documenting, and sustaining scalable global HR operational foundations, including standard operating procedures, checklists, service expectations, controls, data-quality practices, and audit support.
* Experience partnering with insurance providers, benefits brokers, third-party administrators, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT, managers, and other internal and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience using HRIS, benefits administration, payroll, case-management, and document-management systems, with a record of maintaining accurate, complete, and audit-ready employee data.
* Strong attention to detail, operational discipline, and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, employee requests, transactions, and compliance-sensitive processes simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain benefits and HR processes clearly and provide responsive, employee-friendly service across global teams and time zones.
* Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential and sensitive employee information, combined with a proactive, service-oriented mindset and a focus on process improvement, scalable controls, and employee experience.

At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

**Role purpose**

The Senior Manager, IAM leads delivery and continuous improvement of identity services that help protect Amgen’s people, information, systems, and operations. The role provides operational leadership across Provisioning and Identity Governance, Access Management, Directory Services, and Privileged Access Management (PAM), while partnering with global service owners, technology teams, business stakeholders, and strategic suppliers. The position may requires working in US EST shifts, including occasional extended-hours coverage, to support global operations, critical incidents, and effective handovers across time zones.

The role combines service management, technical and architectural governance, risk reduction, transformation delivery, and people leadership. It operates in a global, highly regulated biopharmaceutical environment where availability, data protection, auditability, and business continuity are essential.

**Primary function**

Lead IAM operations and service delivery across multiple platforms. Set clear priorities for incident, problem, change, request, and compliance work; maintain service availability and agreed service levels; and ensure timely risk-based response to issues. Translate IAM strategy, policies, and control requirements into operational practices and technology outcomes. Build a strong team culture, develop talent, manage capacity, and strengthen collaboration across locations and functions.

**Core responsibilities**

**IAM service operations and resilience**

Lead operational delivery across identity provisioning and governance, access management, directory services, and PAM, coordinating work across India, the United States, Portugal, and suppliers as applicable.

Own service performance, operational health, availability, service-level objectives, backlogs, and capacity plans; review trends and take action before service or control risks grow.

Provide incident leadership for IAM service disruptions and security events: establish severity, coordinate responders, prioritize containment and recovery, communicate clearly, and engage business continuity and crisis teams when needed.

Oversee problem management and root-cause analysis. Ensure corrective and preventive actions are assigned, tracked, and reflected in runbooks, monitoring, architecture, and control improvements.

Govern operational changes, maintenance, release readiness, and supplier delivery to protect production stability and ensure adequate testing, rollback plans, and stakeholder readiness.

Maintain operational readiness through monitoring, alerting, service documentation, support models, knowledge transfer, and succession plans for critical systems and roles.

**Identity strategy, platforms, and transformation**

Execute the IAM roadmap and translate business, security, privacy, and regulatory needs into prioritized, supportable solutions and measurable outcomes.

Guide implementation, integration, migration, and modernization across IAM platforms, including IBM Security Identity Manager (ISIM), SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC), Microsoft Entra, on-premises Active Directory, CyberArk, BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (Avecto), and Sectigo certificate services, as relevant to the environment.

Partner with enterprise architecture, application, infrastructure, cloud, network, endpoint, HR, and business teams to deliver secure identity patterns and resolve dependencies.

Provide technical and delivery assurance: review solution designs, operational readiness, integrations, test evidence, supportability, and adherence to architecture and security standards.

Contribute to identity lifecycle and governance for human, privileged, and non-human identities, including service accounts and other machine identities, in coordination with accountable security and platform owners.

**Risk, compliance, and governance**

Ensure IAM processes and platforms support applicable corporate policies, security controls, privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations in the biopharmaceutical environment.

Maintain audit-ready evidence for access governance, privileged access, change management, incident response, supplier oversight, and control operation; coordinate remediation of findings and control gaps.

Assess operational and technology risks, document decisions and exceptions, and prioritize mitigations according to business impact and risk appetite.

Ensure access is provisioned, changed, reviewed, and removed through authorized, traceable processes; strengthen segregation of duties and least-privilege practices.

Oversee supplier performance, deliverables, service levels, quality, and risk actions; clarify accountability between internal service owners and delivery partners.

**Stakeholder leadership and communication**

Build trusted relationships with global IAM service owners, cybersecurity leaders, business and application owners, control functions, and suppliers.

Communicate service health, material incidents, risks, decisions, dependencies, and recovery plans in a timely manner, tailoring detail to technical and executive audiences.

Facilitate cross-functional prioritization and resolve ownership or capacity conflicts with a focus on business outcomes and continuity.

Represent IAM operations in governance forums, audits, architecture reviews, and transformation steering discussions; present concise, evidence-based recommendations.

**People management responsibilities**

Provide clear direction, connect team priorities to organizational goals, role-model Amgen values, and create an environment where people can raise concerns and offer ideas.

Lead managers and individual contributors as applicable; establish regular 1:1s, team forums, skip-level conversations, and transparent communication of business context and organizational updates.

Monitor engagement and pulse feedback, agree measurable action plans with the team, and follow through. Promote inclusion, fairness, and equal opportunity.

Set clear goals and expectations; provide timely coaching and feedback; complete fair, well-differentiated performance evaluations and contribute constructively to calibration.

Build individual development plans aligned with strengths and career aspirations. Provide stretch assignments, technical learning, leadership development, and cross-functional exposure.

Address performance concerns promptly and consistently, partnering with HR and following company processes where formal action is needed.

Identify critical roles, key-person dependencies, succession options, and retention risks; develop bench strength and maintain continuity plans.

Forecast skills and capacity needs, define hiring profiles, participate in recruitment, and align staffing and supplier capacity with demand and budget.

Handle employee concerns and sensitive matters promptly, fairly, and confidentially, engaging HR and escalating appropriately.

Ensure people-management practices and records comply with company policy and support audit readiness and business continuity.

**Qualifications and experience**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.

Typically 12+ years of experience in IAM, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or related technology functions, including substantial responsibility for enterprise IAM service delivery.

title: Delivery Director
description:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

We're looking for a Delivery Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation: a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and still growing. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a governance role sitting apart from the work. You'll take direct ownership of how delivery runs day to day, build a high-performing team, and set the tone for its spirit.

You'll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM, who hold technical direction for their respective practices. As the most senior Two Circles leader in Hyderabad, you'll also play an important role in our work with BCCI, our most important partner in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Leading the Team and Its Spirit

* Lead, grow and retain the India delivery team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the spirit of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat this as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and Engineering Excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Partner with our Tech Leads and Engineering Directors to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed and executed well.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, Metrics and Governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team, covering hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality, performance and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how project leaders elsewhere in the business rate the India team's work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
* Keep any scorecard or metrics simple and supportive, not a tool that creates pressure. Psychological safety and performance measurement need to be built together, not treated as separate things.

Client Leadership

* Act as Client Lead for BCCI: our most senior relationship owner in India, accountable for client governance and margin efficiency. We'd expect this to take up roughly 10% of your time.
* Represent our engineering and delivery capability in client meetings in India, drawing on the work we deliver globally.

Global Collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues, and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong spirit in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team's health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**

Proven experience building, scaling and leading complex delivery organisations at scale (50+ people) spanning engineering, QA and delivery, including experience managing managers.

* A delivery and operator mindset first. Genuine fluency across data and digital product engineering, sufficient to work credibly with Tech Leads and architects on trade-offs, quality and risk, without requiring a hands-on engineering background yourself.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* A demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, across technical, commercial and client audiences.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Eligible to work in India.

Nice to Have

* A formal delivery or PMO background, or certification (Scrum, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

Location and Travel

Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate to Hyderabad.

Able to travel to Vancouver, London, and Melbourne twice a year.
